songs.note: The best-known 中国风 song of all. Every line paints a piece of blue-and-white porcelain — “the sky-blue glaze waits for the misty rain, and I am waiting for you.” It won Song of the Year at Taiwan's 2008 Golden Melody Awards.
songs.noteZh: 中国风最有名的一首，获 2008 年金曲奖年度歌曲：「天青色等烟雨，而我在等你」。

songs.note: A landmark of the 中国风 style (2003): a pop melody played with the erhu and the pipa. 破 here doesn't mean “broken” — it comes from 曲破, a form of old folk tune.
songs.noteZh: 中国风的代表作，用了二胡和琵琶；歌名里的「破」来自古代曲子的一种形式「曲破」。

songs.note: A love that waits across lifetimes — until the singer's hair turns as white as snow. The lyrics are full of classical images: moonlight, frost, an old lantern.
songs.noteZh: 等一个人，等到头发像雪一样白。

songs.note: Theme song of Zhang Yimou's film Curse of the Golden Flower (满城尽带黄金甲); it won Best Original Film Song at the 2007 Hong Kong Film Awards. In Chinese poetry the chrysanthemum belongs to autumn and quiet sorrow.
songs.noteZh: 张艺谋电影《满城尽带黄金甲》的主题曲，获香港电影金像奖最佳原创电影歌曲。

songs.note: A duet with Fei Yu-ching, a much-loved singer of an older generation — Jay's modern voice answers Fei's smooth classic style. 里 is a traditional unit of distance (about half a kilometre), so 千里 means “very, very far”.
songs.noteZh: 周杰伦和费玉清的合唱；「里」是古代的长度单位，「千里」就是很远很远。

songs.note: Named after Wang Xizhi's “Preface to the Orchid Pavilion” (353 AD), called “the finest running script under heaven” — the most celebrated work in the history of Chinese calligraphy. The song tells a love story in brush and ink.
songs.noteZh: 歌名来自东晋王羲之的《兰亭集序》，被称为「天下第一行书」。

songs.note: Set in the city of Luoyang some 1,500 years ago: a general, the woman he loves, and a great city that rises and falls. Fireworks are beautiful — and gone in a moment.
songs.noteZh: 故事发生在一千五百多年前盛极而衰的洛阳；烟花很美，却很快就冷了。

songs.en: The Inn of the Mortal World
songs.note: 红尘 “red dust” is a Buddhist word for the busy everyday world; 客栈 is the roadside inn where heroes meet in martial-arts (wuxia) stories.
songs.noteZh: 「红尘」指人世间，「客栈」是武侠故事里的旅店。

songs.note: Another wuxia story, like 红尘客栈: a lone swordsman wandering the jianghu (江湖), the world of martial heroes. 天涯 is “the edge of the sky” — the ends of the earth.
songs.noteZh: 又一首武侠风：「天涯」是天边、很远的地方，「过客」是路过的人。

songs.note: 娘子 is how a husband addressed his wife in old China. In the song she breaks off a willow branch every day while she waits for him — the willow (柳) has long been a symbol of parting and longing.
songs.noteZh: 「娘子」是古时候丈夫对妻子的称呼；折柳是送别和思念的象征。

songs.note: A warm song about family and tea. It name-checks Lu Yu, the Tang-dynasty scholar who wrote The Classic of Tea (茶经), the world's first book about tea.
songs.noteZh: 关于家和茶的歌，歌里提到了写《茶经》的唐代「茶圣」陆羽。

songs.note: Named after the Compendium of Materia Medica by the Ming-dynasty doctor Li Shizhen, China's great book of herbal medicine. A fast hip-hop beat with a proud “Chinese style” message.
songs.noteZh: 歌名来自明代李时珍的中医药巨著《本草纲目》。

songs.note: 江南 is the land south of the Yangtze River — water towns, stone bridges and soft spring rain. This JJ Lin hit is one of the best-loved Chinese songs of the 2000s.
songs.noteZh: 「江南」指长江以南，小桥流水、烟雨蒙蒙的地方。

songs.note: Cao Cao was the most famous — and most argued-about — warlord of the Three Kingdoms period (see 三国恋). Hero or villain? People in China still debate it.
songs.noteZh: 曹操是三国时代最有名的人物之一，是英雄还是奸雄，至今众说纷纭。

songs.note: A song for you! “The whole world is learning Chinese” — S.H.E sing about Chinese spreading around the globe, and slip a famous tongue twister (绕口令) into the middle.
songs.noteZh: 「全世界都在学中国话」——歌里还唱了一段绕口令。

songs.note: From the album Heroes of Earth (盖世英雄, 2005), where Wang Leehom mixes R&B with Peking-opera singing. 花田错 is also the name of a classic Peking opera comedy.
songs.noteZh: 把京剧唱腔和 R&B 混在一起；《花田错》也是一出京剧的名字。

songs.note: Title song of the same 2005 album as 花田错. Wang Leehom mixes hip-hop with real Peking opera — the track features the opera performer Li Yan.
songs.noteZh: 和《花田错》出自同一张专辑：嘻哈加京剧，还请来了京剧演员李岩。

songs.note: Set in the Three Kingdoms period (220–280 AD), the age of heroes made famous by the novel Romance of the Three Kingdoms.
songs.noteZh: 背景是三国时代——《三国演义》里的英雄年代。

songs.note: From the 2006 fantasy TV drama The Little Fairy (天外飞仙), based on the folk tale of a fairy who falls in love with a mortal. A love that keeps waiting for a thousand years.
songs.noteZh: 电视剧《天外飞仙》的歌曲，故事来自民间传说「天仙配」。

songs.note: 牡丹, the peony, has long been called the “king of flowers” in China. 牡丹江 is also a real river and city in Heilongjiang, in China's far north-east.
songs.noteZh: 牡丹被称为「花中之王」；牡丹江也是黑龙江的一条江、一座城。

songs.note: Opening theme of the hit 2017 drama Eternal Love (三生三世十里桃花), first sung by Jason Zhang (张杰). Here singer-songwriter Su Yunying gives it her own airy, unusual voice. 三生 — past, present and future lives — comes from Buddhist thought.
songs.noteZh: 电视剧《三生三世十里桃花》的片头曲，原唱张杰；这里是苏运莹的现场翻唱版。

songs.note: The closing theme of Eternal Love — the same drama as 三生三世, so the two make a pair. Two voices, one sad farewell: 凉 “cool” is a heart gone cold.
songs.noteZh: 电视剧《三生三世十里桃花》的片尾曲，和《三生三世》正好是一对。

songs.note: 庐州 is the old name of Hefei, capital of Anhui province. Under the moon the singer misses home and an old love — in Chinese poetry the moon is the classic symbol of homesickness.
songs.noteZh: 庐州是合肥的古称；月亮是中国人思乡的象征。

songs.note: 清明 (Qingming, in early April) is the day Chinese families sweep their ancestors' tombs — and it is famous for drizzle, as the Tang poet Du Mu wrote: 清明时节雨纷纷.
songs.noteZh: 清明节是扫墓、怀念亲人的日子；杜牧诗云「清明时节雨纷纷」。

songs.note: The Su Causeway crosses West Lake in Hangzhou. It was built by the poet Su Shi (Su Dongpo) when he governed the city. The lyrics walk past lake sights like 花港观鱼 and Leifeng Pagoda.
songs.noteZh: 杭州西湖上的苏堤，由诗人苏轼主持修建。

songs.note: The song for the animated film Big Fish & Begonia (大鱼海棠, 2016), whose story draws on ancient books such as the Zhuangzi — this MV is cut from the film's animation. Zhou Shen's high, clear voice made it famous.
songs.noteZh: 动画电影《大鱼海棠》的印象曲；电影取材于《庄子·逍遥游》等古书。

songs.note: A quiet 古风 (gǔfēng, “ancient style”) song. 古风 is a sister genre of 中国风, born online, with lyrics written like classical poetry and sung softly, almost in a whisper.
songs.noteZh: 古风歌曲：歌词像古诗词，唱得轻柔安静。

songs.note: Huo Zun became famous overnight with this song on the TV show Sing My Song (中国好歌曲) in 2014, and sang it at that year's CCTV Spring Festival Gala. A curtain of pearls or beads hung in the doorways of old Chinese homes — rolling it up means looking out, waiting for someone.
songs.noteZh: 霍尊凭这首歌在 2014 年《中国好歌曲》一炮而红，同年登上央视春晚。

songs.note: The theme song of the 2005 TV drama Chinese Paladin (仙剑奇侠传, starring Hu Ge and Liu Yifei), based on a classic martial-arts fantasy video game; this MV is cut from the drama. JS are a brother-and-sister duo from Taiwan. The title names three stars of Chinese astrology — 七杀 Seven Killings, 破军 Army-Breaker and 贪狼 Greedy Wolf.
songs.noteZh: 2005 年电视剧《仙剑奇侠传》（胡歌、刘亦菲主演）的主题曲，由台湾兄妹组合 JS 创作演唱；这支 MV 剪自剧中画面。

songs.note: Hu Ge played the hero Li Xiaoyao (李逍遥) in Chinese Paladin (仙剑奇侠传, 2005) and sang this song for the drama himself — the title borrows his character's name. 逍遥 means free and unfettered, a Daoist ideal of drifting through life without ties.
songs.noteZh: 胡歌在《仙剑奇侠传》里演主角李逍遥，这首插曲也由他亲自演唱，歌名就取自角色的名字。

songs.note: A second song Hu Ge sang for Chinese Paladin (仙剑奇侠传, 2005); the MV is cut from the drama, with Liu Yifei as Zhao Ling'er (赵灵儿). June is the rainy season across southern China.
songs.noteZh: 胡歌为《仙剑奇侠传》唱的另一首插曲，MV 剪自剧中李逍遥和赵灵儿的画面。

songs.note: An insert song of Chinese Paladin (仙剑奇侠传, 2005), sung from the side of the one left out of a love triangle. A-Sang, a Taiwanese singer loved for her husky, healing voice, died of breast cancer in 2009 at just 34.
songs.noteZh: 《仙剑奇侠传》插曲。那句「明明是三个人的电影，我却始终不能有姓名」唱出了三角恋里被冷落的一方。阿桑 2009 年因乳癌病逝，年仅 34 岁。

songs.note: The opening theme of Chinese Paladin 3 (仙剑奇侠传三, 2009), starring Hu Ge, Yang Mi, Wallace Huo, Liu Shishi and Tiffany Tang. Its story is a tangle of past lives and this life — hence a love that lasts 生生世世, life after life. Kary Ng is a Hong Kong singer.
songs.noteZh: 《仙剑奇侠传三》片头曲，香港歌手吴雨霏演唱。剧情讲的正是前世今生的爱恨纠葛。

songs.note: An insert song of Chinese Paladin 3 (2009) that became Taiwanese singer Jing Chang's best-known song. 偏爱 is loving one person more than reason says you should.
songs.noteZh: 《仙剑奇侠传三》插曲，台湾歌手张芸京的代表作。

words.en: to favour, love one above all
a song featured in a film or drama

songs.note: The ending theme of Chinese Paladin 3 (2009), sung by Hu Ge, who played its hero Jing Tian (景天) — four years after his breakout in the first Chinese Paladin.
songs.noteZh: 《仙剑奇侠传三》片尾曲，由剧中饰演景天的胡歌演唱。

songs.note: The opening theme of the 2006 TV series The Return of the Condor Heroes (神雕侠侣), from Jin Yong's martial-arts novel — Huang Xiaoming as Yang Guo and Liu Yifei as Xiaolongnü (小龙女). 天下 'all under heaven' is the old Chinese word for the whole world.
songs.noteZh: 2006 年电视剧《神雕侠侣》（黄晓明、刘亦菲主演）的片头曲，改编自金庸武侠小说。

words.en: the whole world (lit. all under heaven)

songs.en: A Life of Fighting Is but a Dream
songs.note: The theme of the 1994 Taiwanese TV series Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre (倚天屠龙记), from Jin Yong's novel, starring Ma Jingtao, Cecilia Yip and Kathy Chow; this MV is cut from Kathy Chow's scenes as Zhou Zhiruo (周芷若). Jin Yong (金庸) is the best-loved martial-arts novelist in Chinese.
songs.noteZh: 1994 年台视版《倚天屠龙记》（马景涛、叶童、周海媚主演）的主题曲；这支 MV 剪自周海媚饰演周芷若的片段。

songs.note: The ending theme of the 2006 Return of the Condor Heroes, sung together by Wakin Chau, the producer Zhang Jizhong and the actors Hu Jun and Huang Xiaoming. 江湖 (lit. rivers and lakes) is the wandering world of swordsmen outside the law — the setting of every wuxia story.
songs.noteZh: 2006 年《神雕侠侣》片尾曲，由周华健与制片人张纪中、演员胡军、黄晓明等合唱。

words.en: the martial world of wandering swordsmen
debts of kindness and old grudges

songs.note: The Mandarin version of 神话·情话, the theme of the 1995 Hong Kong TV series The Condor Heroes (神雕侠侣) — the Hong Kong broadcast used the Cantonese version. This MV is cut from that series, with Louis Koo as Yang Guo and Carman Lee as Xiaolongnü.
songs.noteZh: 1995 年 TVB 版《神雕侠侣》主题曲《神话·情话》的国语版（港版播的是粤语版）；MV 剪自古天乐、李若彤主演的原剧。

songs.note: The closing song of the 1993 Hong Kong film Butterfly & Sword (新流星蝴蝶剑), from Gu Long's wuxia novel, starring Tony Leung, Michelle Yeoh, Joey Wong and Donnie Yen — sung by Michelle Yeoh herself, words and music by Li Zongsheng. The MV is cut from the film.
songs.noteZh: 1993 年港片《新流星蝴蝶剑》片尾曲，由主演杨紫琼亲自演唱，李宗盛词曲；MV 剪自电影画面。

songs.en: A Laugh Over the Vast Sea
songs.artist: 黄霑 · 徐克 · 罗大佑
songs.artistEn: James Wong, Tsui Hark & Lo Ta-yu
songs.note: From the 1990 Hong Kong film Swordsman (笑傲江湖). James Wong (黄霑) built the melody on the five-note Chinese scale 宫商角徵羽 run backwards, which is why it sounds so ancient; this version is sung by Wong with the film's producer Tsui Hark and singer Lo Ta-yu, over scenes from the film.
songs.noteZh: 1990 年港片《笑傲江湖》主题曲。黄霑把五声音阶「宫商角徵羽」倒过来写成旋律；这一版由黄霑、徐克、罗大佑合唱，配电影画面。

songs.note: The theme song of the 1995 Hong Kong series The Condor Heroes (神雕侠侣) as broadcast in mainland China, composed by Xiao Ke; the MV is cut from the series, with Louis Koo and Carman Lee. The title echoes Tao Yuanming's famous poem 归去来兮辞 (c. 405 AD), about quitting office to go home to the fields.
songs.noteZh: 1995 年 TVB 版《神雕侠侣》大陆播出版的主题曲，小柯作曲；MV 剪自古天乐、李若彤主演的原剧。歌名呼应陶渊明的《归去来兮辞》。

songs.note: The theme song of The Legend of Qin (秦时明月, 2007), mainland China's first 3D wuxia animation, set as the Qin dynasty unites China (221 BC); Hu Yanbin composed it himself. The MV is cut from the animation.
songs.noteZh: 动画《秦时明月》主题曲，胡彦斌作曲并演唱；MV 剪自动画画面。《秦时明月》是中国大陆首部三维武侠动画。
